Class DarkJediTermSettings

java.lang.Object
com.jediterm.terminal.ui.settings.DefaultSettingsProvider
org.casserole.app.ui.ssh.DarkJediTermSettings
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.jediterm.terminal.ui.settings.SettingsProvider, com.jediterm.terminal.ui.settings.SystemSettingsProvider, com.jediterm.terminal.ui.settings.UserSettingsProvider
Direct Known Subclasses:
AetherisNotebookPanel.MoodGlassSettings
public class DarkJediTermSettings extends com.jediterm.terminal.ui.settings.DefaultSettingsProvider
The DarkJediTermSettings type is the JediTerm settings object for the dark terminal. The name JediTerm means the terminal widget these settings configure. The font size can change without building a new widget. The new size stays unused until the terminal panel runs reinitFontAndResize. The method DarkJediTermWidget.applyFontSize() makes that call. The scrollback stays at SCROLLBACK_LINES lines. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#DarkJediTermSettings

  • Constructor Details

    • DarkJediTermSettings

      public DarkJediTermSettings(SshClientProperties properties)
      The constructor reads the terminal colors and the font size from the properties. The constructor reads each color from SshClientProperties.getColor(String, String) with the matching default hex. The foreground key is SshClientProperties.UI_TERMINAL_COLOR_FOREGROUND. The background key is SshClientProperties.UI_TERMINAL_COLOR_BACKGROUND. The selection foreground key is SshClientProperties.UI_TERMINAL_COLOR_SELECTION_FOREGROUND. The selection background key is SshClientProperties.UI_TERMINAL_COLOR_SELECTION_BACKGROUND. The stored color keeps the red, green, and blue channels. The stored color drops the alpha channel. The font size is the int from SshClientProperties.getFontSize(), stored as a float.
      Parameters:
      properties - The color and font source.

    • setTerminalFontSize

      public void setTerminalFontSize(float fontSize)
      The setTerminalFontSize method stores a new point size. The method does not resize the terminal grid. The grid changes when the panel runs reinitFontAndResize. The method DarkJediTermWidget.applyFontSize() makes that call.
      Parameters:
      fontSize - The point size to store.

    • getTerminalFont

      public Font getTerminalFont()
      The getTerminalFont method picks a plain monospaced font for the operating system. The name comes from the os.name property, read in lower case, and a missing property is an empty string. The method uses Consolas when that name contains win. The method uses Menlo when that name contains mac. The method uses Monospaced for every other name. The style is plain. The size is the stored point size cast to an int, which drops the fraction.
      Specified by:
      getTerminalFont in interface com.jediterm.terminal.ui.settings.UserSettingsProvider
      Overrides:
      getTerminalFont in class com.jediterm.terminal.ui.settings.DefaultSettingsProvider
      Returns:
      The return value is that font.
